_comment: Reusable knowledge for React/SPA sites (no AEM cmp-* markup) that expose components via data-testid and semantic class roots. The extractor's SPA mode groups data-testid attributes into these block families; build-catalog maps them like AEM components. Keyed by a testid *prefix/family*; `block` is the catalog id, `page` is a page-type hint used by the classifier. Extend as new sites/components appear.
_cssModuleDoc: For Next.js/React sites using CSS-Modules (class names like `product-selector_root__QXmw0` or `vm-hero-section`), the extractor keys components by the module prefix. cssModuleIgnore lists structural/layout/form-control/nav/default-content module names to drop (never authored blocks). cssModuleBlocks remaps a module prefix onto a canonical catalog block id so a coded section family (e.g. all vehicle-make/model sections) collapses into one buildable block. Anything not ignored/remapped becomes its own catalog id and is matched against `blocks` below.
_blockVariationsDoc: Detect distinct VARIATIONS of a block from testid signals on the same page. When a block is present, if a variation's `signal` testid(s) match, tag that variation; else fall back to `default`. Lets one block (e.g. product-detail) report meaningfully different configurations (standard vs contact-lens/vision) with their own functional detail.
